history.content: Hey, good to see you. I’m here and paying attention, how’s your day been so far?
eh. fine i guess. bit of a rough one honestly
That sounds like one of those days that’s been wearing on you. If you want, you can tell me the rough part.
i checked my bank account this morning and its just. embarrassing. 31 and ive got nothing saved. cant even cover my half of rent this month
That sounds heavy and a bit humiliating, and the rent part makes it feel more pressing. Is it closer to embarrassment, pressure, or something else?
embarrassment yeah. like everyone my age has their stuff together and im just. behind. feels like im failing at being an adult
Yeah, embarrassment fits, and there’s a sharp self-check in “failing at being an adult.” What does it make you want to do, hide, explain, or fix it?
hide it mostly. dont really talk about it. anyway. thanks for listening, gotta go
Of course, I’ll leave it there, and I’m glad you stopped by.
